qualification.rationale: Ardent Industries Inc. is a precision sheet metal fabrication, CNC machining, powder coating, and welding manufacturer serving B2B and industrial sectors (semiconductor, robotics, chemical processing, automotive aftermarket). It is outside ForgeX's target segment of owner-led home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical).
